<script>

// ─ Helpers
function initials(n){return(n||'?').split(' ').map(x=>x[0]).join('').substring(0,2).toUpperCase();}
function typeTag(t){const c=TYPE_COLORS[t]||{bg:'#F1EFE8',text:'#444441'};return `<span class="badge" style="background:${c.bg};color:${c.text}">${t||'Unknown'}</span>`;}
function fmtTime(dt){if(!dt)return '—';return new Date(dt).toLocaleTimeString('en-GB',{hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit'});}
function fmtDate(dt){if(!dt)return '—';return new Date(dt).toLocaleDateString('en-GB',{day:'2-digit',month:'short',year:'2-digit'});}
function fmtFull(dt){if(!dt)return '—';return new Date(dt).toLocaleString('en-GB',{day:'2-digit',month:'short',year:'numeric',hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit'});}
function duration(a,b){if(!a||!b)return '—';const d=new Date(b)-new Date(a);if(d<0)return '—';const h=Math.floor(d/3600000),m=Math.floor((d%3600000)/60000);return h>0?`${h}h ${m}m`:`${m}m`;}
function statusBadge(s){const m={'Checked In':'b-in','Checked Out':'b-out','Scheduled':'b-scheduled','Expired':'b-out'};return `<span class="badge ${m[s]||'b-out'}">${s||'Unknown'}</span>`;}
function transportChip(t){const i=TRANSPORT_ICONS[t]||'fa-question';return `<span class="transport-chip"><i class="fa-solid ${i}" style="font-size:11px"></i>${t||'—'}</span>`;}
function getCookie(name){const m=document.cookie.match(new RegExp('(?:^|; )'+name+'=([^;]*)'));return m?decodeURIComponent(m[1]):'';}

// ─ Data
async function loadData(){
  document.getElementById('lastRefresh').textContent='Refreshing...';
  document.getElementById('liveIndicator').style.color='#BA7517';
  try{
    const fields=FIELDS.split(',').map(f=>`%22${f}%22`).join(',');
    const r=await fetch(`${BASE}/api/resource/Appointment?fields=[${fields}]&limit=500&order_by=scheduled_time+desc`,{headers:{'Accept':'application/json'}});
    if(!r.ok) throw new Error('HTTP '+r.status);
    const j=await r.json();
    allDataRaw=j.data||[];
    document.getElementById('lastRefresh').textContent='Updated '+new Date().toLocaleTimeString('en-GB',{hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit'});
    document.getElementById('liveIndicator').style.color='#639922';
    await populateFilters();
    applyGlobalFilter();
    if(incidentsBooted) loadIncidents();
    if(patrolsBooted) loadPatrols();
    if(shiftsBooted) loadShifts();
  }catch(e){
    document.getElementById('lastRefresh').textContent='Error: '+e.message;
    document.getElementById('liveIndicator').style.color='#A32D2D';
  }
}

async function populateFilters(){
  const cos=[...new Set(allDataRaw.filter(r=>r.custom_visitor_type==='Contractor'&&r.custom_contractor_ref).map(r=>r.custom_contractor_ref))].sort();

    s.value=v;
  });

  // real Company / Farm doctypes, not derived from whatever Appointment records happen to
  // exist, so they stay usable even when no visitor/contractor data references a farm yet.
  try{
    const [companies,farms]=await Promise.all([
      callMethod('frappe.client.get_list',{doctype:'Company',fields:['name'],order_by:'name asc',limit_page_length:200}),
      callMethod('frappe.client.get_list',{doctype:'Farm',fields:['name'],order_by:'name asc',limit_page_length:500}),
    ]);

}

// ─── PDF TEXT SANITIZER ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// jsPDF uses WinAnsiEncoding (Latin-1 / Windows-1252). Any Unicode character
// outside that code page arrives as garbled multi-byte sequences (â€", Â·, etc.).
// This function replaces every common offender with its plain-ASCII equivalent
// before anything is handed to jsPDF or jspdf-autotable.
function sanitizePdfText(val) {
  if (val === null || val === undefined) return '';
  const s = String(val);
  return s
    // Dashes
    .replace(/[\u2014\u2015]/g, '--')   // em dash / horizontal bar
    .replace(/[\u2012\u2013]/g, '-')    // en dash / figure dash
    .replace(/\u2010/g, '-')            // hyphen
    // Quotation marks
    .replace(/[\u2018\u2019]/g, "'")    // curly single quotes
    .replace(/[\u201C\u201D]/g, '"')    // curly double quotes
    .replace(/[\u2039\u203A]/g, "'")    // single angle quotes
    .replace(/[\u00AB\u00BB]/g, '"')    // double angle quotes
    // Spaces & formatting
    .replace(/[\u00A0\u202F\u2009\u2008\u2007\u2006\u2005\u2004\u2003\u2002\u2001\u2000]/g, ' ') // non-breaking / thin / other spaces
    .replace(/\u2026/g, '...')          // ellipsis
    // Bullets & middot
    .replace(/[\u00B7\u2022\u2023\u2043\u2219]/g, '*') // middle dot / bullets
    // Ligatures
    .replace(/\uFB00/g, 'ff').replace(/\uFB01/g, 'fi').replace(/\uFB02/g, 'fl')
    .replace(/\uFB03/g, 'ffi').replace(/\uFB04/g, 'ffl')
    // Currency (outside WinAnsi range on some renderers)
    .replace(/\u20AC/g, 'EUR')          // euro sign — actually IS in WinAnsi at 0x80, but kept for safety
    .replace(/\u00A3/g, 'GBP')          // pound sign
    // Misc
    .replace(/\u00D7/g, 'x')            // multiplication sign
    .replace(/\u00F7/g, '/')            // division sign
    .replace(/\u2122/g, 'TM')           // trade mark
    .replace(/\u00AE/g, '(R)')          // registered
    .replace(/\u00A9/g, '(c)')          // copyright
    // Strip any remaining non-Latin-1 characters (code points > 255)
    .replace(/[^\x00-\xFF]/g, '?');
}

// Wrap a value for use in autoTable — handles both plain strings and statusCell objects.
function pdfCell(val, styles) {
  const clean = sanitizePdfText(val);
  return styles ? { content: clean, styles } : clean;
}

function pdfFmtTime(dt){if(!dt)return '-';return new Date(dt).toLocaleTimeString('en-GB',{hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit'});}
function pdfFmtDate(dt){if(!dt)return '-';return new Date(dt).toLocaleDateString('en-GB',{day:'2-digit',month:'short',year:'2-digit'});}
function pdfDur(a,b){if(!a||!b)return '-';const d=new Date(b)-new Date(a);if(d<0)return '-';const h=Math.floor(d/3600000),m=Math.floor((d%3600000)/60000);return h>0?`${h}h ${m}m`:`${m}m`;}

  if(typeof probe.autoTable !== 'function'){

  const date = document.getElementById('reportDate').value || new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10);

  const inDay = (r) => {
    const t = new Date(r.scheduled_time || r.custom_check_in_time).getTime();
    return t >= dayStart && t <= dayEnd;
  };
  const dayData = allData.filter(inDay);
  const MAX_ROWS = 800;
  if(dayData.length > MAX_ROWS) dayData.length = MAX_ROWS;

  const visitors    = dayData.filter(r=>r.custom_visitor_type!=='Contractor');

  });

  const yieldToBrowser = () => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 0));

  const doc   = new jsPDF('p','mm','a4');

  const BLUE_LT  = [230, 241, 251], BLUE_DK  = [12, 68, 124];
  const MUTED    = [107, 107, 103];

  function statusCell(s){
    let fill = GRAY_LT, text = GRAY_DK;
    if(s==='Checked In'){ fill = GREEN_LT; text = GREEN_DK; }
    else if(s==='Scheduled'){ fill = BLUE_LT; text = BLUE_DK; }

  function drawHeader(){
    doc.setFillColor(...BLUE);

    doc.setFontSize(10);

    doc.setFontSize(8);

    doc.text('Generated ' + sanitizePdfText(new Date().toLocaleString('en-GB')), margin, 24);
    doc.setTextColor(0,0,0);
  }

  function drawFooter(){
    const total = doc.internal.getNumberOfPages();
    for(let p=1; p<=total; p++){
      doc.setPage(p);
      doc.setFillColor(...BLUE);
      doc.rect(0, pageH - 8, pageW, 8, 'F');
      doc.setTextColor(255,255,255);

        sanitizePdfText(`Security Dashboard  -  ${new Date().toLocaleString('en-GB')}  -  Page ${p} of ${total}`),

  function sectionTitle(y, icon, title){

    doc.setTextColor(...BLUE);

  let cursorY = 36;

// ─── SESSION / CSRF HELPERS ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Frappe rotates the csrf_token cookie on EVERY response. Reading it once and
// reusing it across multiple fetch() calls causes CSRFTokenError on the second
// call. The correct pattern is: always read getCsrf() immediately before the
// fetch that needs it — never cache it across awaits.
//
// Additionally, when the Frappe session has expired the server returns:
//   503  {"exc_type":"SessionStopped"}   — session timed out
//   401/403                              — not authenticated
// We detect both and show a friendly login link instead of a raw error.

function getCsrf() {
  // Always read live from the cookie — never use a cached value.
  return getCookie('csrf_token') || (window.frappe && window.frappe.csrf_token) || '';
}

class SessionExpiredError extends Error {
  constructor(msg) { super(msg); this.name = 'SessionExpiredError'; }
}

function isSessionError(status, text) {
  if (status === 401 || status === 403) return true;
  if (status === 503 && text.includes('SessionStopped')) return true;
  if (status === 400 && text.includes('CSRFTokenError')) return true;
  return false;
}

async function checkSession() {
  // Ping a lightweight endpoint. Frappe will refresh the session server-side
  // and set a new csrf_token cookie in the response — which getCsrf() will
  // pick up on the very next call.
  const r = await fetch(BASE + '/api/method/frappe.auth.get_logged_user', {
    credentials: 'include',
    headers: { 'Accept': 'application/json', 'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest' }
  });
  const text = await r.text();
  if (isSessionError(r.status, text)) {
    throw new SessionExpiredError('Your session has expired. Please log in again.');
  }
  if (!r.ok) throw new Error('Session check failed: HTTP ' + r.status);
  // Cookie is now refreshed — subsequent getCsrf() calls will return the new token.
}

function showLoginPrompt() {
  const loginUrl = BASE + '/login?redirect-to=' + encodeURIComponent(window.location.pathname + window.location.search);
  showStatus('error',

    `<a href="${loginUrl}" style="font-weight:600;text-decoration:underline">Click here to log in</a>, ` +
    'then try sending again.'
  );
}

async function sendReportNow(){
  if(!recipients.length){showStatus('error','Please add at least one recipient first.');return;}
  const btn = document.getElementById('sendNowBtn');
  btn.disabled = true;
  const date      = document.getElementById('reportDate').value || new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10);
  const dateLabel = new Date(date+'T12:00:00').toLocaleDateString('en-GB',{weekday:'long',day:'numeric',month:'long',year:'numeric'});
  const subject   = document.getElementById('emailSubject').value || `Security Gate Report - ${dateLabel}`;
  const bodyText  = document.getElementById('emailBody').value || `Please find attached the gate security report for ${dateLabel}.\n\nThis report covers all visitor, contractor and vehicle movements recorded on site.\n\nGenerated automatically from the Security Dashboard.`;

  try{
    // ── Step 0: Confirm session is alive & refresh the CSRF cookie ──
    // Do this BEFORE generating the PDF so the user finds out immediately.
    setProgress(5);
    showStatus('info','<i class="fa-solid fa-spinner fa-spin"></i> Checking session...');
    await checkSession();
    // getCsrf() now returns the fresh token from the updated cookie.

    // ── Step 1: Generate PDF ──
    setProgress(10);
    showStatus('info','<i class="fa-solid fa-spinner fa-spin"></i> Generating PDF...');
    const pdfBlob = await generatePDFBlob();
    setProgress(30);

    const toList   = recipients.map(r=>r.email).join(',');
    const filename = `security_report_${date}.pdf`;

    // ── Step 2: Upload PDF as a Frappe File doc ──
    // Read getCsrf() HERE, immediately before the fetch — not before the await above.
    showStatus('info','<i class="fa-solid fa-spinner fa-spin"></i> Uploading attachment...');
    const uploadForm = new FormData();
    uploadForm.append('file', pdfBlob, filename);
    uploadForm.append('is_private', 0);
    uploadForm.append('folder', 'Home/Attachments');

    const uploadResp = await fetch(BASE + '/api/method/upload_file', {
      method: 'POST', credentials: 'include',
      headers: { 'X-Frappe-CSRF-Token': getCsrf(), 'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest' },
      body: uploadForm
    });

    if(!uploadResp.ok){
      const errText = await uploadResp.text();
      if(isSessionError(uploadResp.status, errText))
        throw new SessionExpiredError('Session expired during upload. Please log in again.');
      throw new Error('Upload failed: HTTP ' + uploadResp.status + ' - ' + errText.slice(0, 300));
    }

    const uploadJson = await uploadResp.json();
    const fileDoc    = uploadJson.message || uploadJson;
    const fileName   = fileDoc.name;
    if(!fileName) throw new Error('Upload succeeded but no File doc name returned: ' + JSON.stringify(fileDoc).slice(0, 200));

    setProgress(60);
    showStatus('info','<i class="fa-solid fa-spinner fa-spin"></i> Sending email...');

    // ── Step 3: Resolve default outgoing Email Account (optional) ──
    let senderField = '';
    try{
      const acctResp = await fetch(
        BASE + '/api/method/frappe.client.get_value?doctype=Email%20Account&filters=' +
        encodeURIComponent('{"default_outgoing":1}') + '&fieldname=' +
        encodeURIComponent('["name","email_id","email_account_name"]'),
        { credentials: 'include' }
      );
      if(acctResp.ok){
        const acct = (await acctResp.json()).message || {};
        if(acct.email_id){
          const dn = acct.email_account_name || acct.name || '';
          senderField = dn ? `${dn} <${acct.email_id}>` : acct.email_id;
        }
      }
    }catch(err){ console.warn('Could not resolve outgoing Email Account:', err); }

    // ── Step 4: Send the email ──
    // Read getCsrf() again HERE — Frappe rotated it when upload_file responded.
    const dashUrl  = window.location.origin + window.location.pathname;
    const htmlBody = bodyText.replace(/\n/g,'<br>')
      + `<br><br><hr style="border:none;border-top:1px solid #e2e2e0;margin:16px 0">`
      + `<p style="font-size:13px;color:#5F5E5A">`
      + `The full report is attached as <strong>${filename}</strong>.<br>`
      + `Open the live dashboard: <a href="${dashUrl}" style="color:#228883">${dashUrl}</a></p>`;

    let senderEmail = senderField, senderName = '';
    const mx = /^([^<]+?)\s*<([^>]+)>\s*$/.exec(senderField);
    if(mx){ senderName = mx[1].trim(); senderEmail = mx[2].trim(); }

    const sendForm = new FormData();
    sendForm.append('recipients', toList);
    sendForm.append('subject', subject);
    sendForm.append('content', htmlBody);
    sendForm.append('send_email', 1);
    sendForm.append('sender', senderEmail);
    if(senderName) sendForm.append('sender_full_name', senderName);
    sendForm.append('send_me_a_copy', 0);
    sendForm.append('attachments', JSON.stringify([fileName]));

    const resp = await fetch(BASE + '/api/method/frappe.core.doctype.communication.email.make', {
      method: 'POST', credentials: 'include',
      headers: { 'X-Frappe-CSRF-Token': getCsrf(), 'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest' },
      body: sendForm
    });
    setProgress(90);
    if(!resp.ok){
      const errText = await resp.text();
      if(isSessionError(resp.status, errText))
        throw new SessionExpiredError('Session expired while sending. Please log in again.');
      throw new Error('Send failed: HTTP ' + resp.status + ' - ' + errText.slice(0, 300));
    }
    setProgress(100);
    showSuccess(`<i class="fa-solid fa-circle-check"></i> Report sent to ${recipients.length} recipient(s):<br>${recipients.map(r=>`<strong>${escHtml(r.name)}</strong> <${escHtml(r.email)}>`).join(', ')}`);

  }catch(e){
    if(e instanceof SessionExpiredError){
      showLoginPrompt();
    } else {
      const date2 = document.getElementById('reportDate').value || new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10);
      showStatus('error',
        `<i class="fa-solid fa-triangle-exclamation"></i> ${e.message} ` +
        `<a href="#" onclick="mailtoFallback('${date2}');return false;" style="font-weight:600;text-decoration:underline">Open in email client instead</a>`
      );
    }
    console.error('Send error:', e);
  }finally{
    btn.disabled = false;
    setProgress(0);
  }
}

async function callMethod(method,args){
  const r=await fetch(BASE+'/api/method/'+method,{method:'POST',credentials:'include',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json','X-Frappe-CSRF-Token':window.csrf_token||(window.frappe&&frappe.csrf_token)||''},body:JSON.stringify(args||{})});
  let j={};
  try{j=await r.json();}catch(e){}
  if(!r.ok){
    let msg='HTTP '+r.status;
    if(j._server_messages){
      try{
        const parsed=JSON.parse(j._server_messages);
        const first=parsed[0];
        if(first){try{const obj=JSON.parse(first);msg=(obj&&obj.message)||first;}catch(e){msg=first;}}
      }catch(e){}
    }else if(j.exception){
      const line=String(j.exception).split('\n').pop();
      if(line)msg=line;
    }else if(j.message&&typeof j.message==='string'){
      msg=j.message;
    }
    throw new Error(msg);
  }
  if(j.exc) throw new Error(j.exc);
  return j.message;
}

    M('fa-seedling','var(--green-lt)','var(--green)',(s.farms_covered||0)+'/'+(s.farms_total||0),'Farms with coverage today','')+
    M('fa-triangle-exclamation','var(--amber-lt)','var(--amber)',s.unfilled_slots||0,'Unfilled slots today',s.unfilled_slots>0?'Day + night gaps':'Fully staffed')+
    M('fa-rotate','var(--purple-lt)','var(--purple)',s.guards_on_rotation||0,'Guards on rotation','Covered 2+ farms');

  // Company filter (static list — populate once)
  const companies=(d.filter_options||{}).companies||[];
  if(!shiftCompanyOptionsLoaded){
    const coF=document.getElementById('shCompanyF');
    const curCo=coF.value;
    coF.innerHTML='<option value="">All companies</option>'+companies.map(c=>`<option value="${escHtml(c)}">${escHtml(c)}</option>`).join('');
    coF.value=curCo;
    shiftCompanyOptionsLoaded=true;
  }

  // Farm filter + form dropdown — repopulated on every render since the option
  // list is scoped to whichever company is currently selected.
  const farms=(d.filter_options||{}).farms||[];
  const farmF=document.getElementById('shFarmF');
  const curFarm=farmF.value;
  farmF.innerHTML='<option value="">All farms</option>'+farms.map(f=>`<option value="${escHtml(f)}">${escHtml(f)}</option>`).join('');
  farmF.value=farms.includes(curFarm)?curFarm:'';
  document.getElementById('shFormFarm').innerHTML=farms.map(f=>`<option value="${escHtml(f)}">${escHtml(f)}</option>`).join('');
  shiftFarmsLoaded=true;

  const board=d.coverage_board||[];
  document.getElementById('shCoverageCount').textContent=board.length+' '+(board.length===1?'farm':'farms');
  document.getElementById('shCoverageTbl').innerHTML=board.length?board.map(row=>{
    const cell=(guardName,shiftType)=>{
      if(guardName){
        return `<span class="badge b-filled">${escHtml(guardName)}</span> <button class="btn btn-sm" title="Rotate to a different farm" onclick='rotateAssignmentPrompt(${attrJson(row.farm)},${attrJson(shiftType)},${attrJson(guardName)})'><i class="fa-solid fa-rotate"></i></button>`;
      }
      return `<span class="badge b-gap">Unassigned</span> <button class="btn btn-sm" onclick='openShiftModal("create",{farm:${attrJson(row.farm)},shift_type:${attrJson(shiftType)}})'><i class="fa-solid fa-plus"></i>Assign</button>`;
    };
    return `<tr><td style="font-weight:500">${escHtml(row.farm||'—')}</td><td>${cell(row.day_guard,'Day')}</td><td>${cell(row.night_guard,'Night')}</td></tr>`;
  }).join(''):'<tr><td colspan="3" class="empty">No farms found</td></tr>';

  const rows=d.rows||[];
  window.__shLastRows=rows;
  document.getElementById('shRowsCount').textContent=rows.length+' '+(rows.length===1?'record':'records');
  document.getElementById('shAssignTbl').innerHTML=rows.length?rows.map(r=>{
    const canCancel=r.status==='Active'||r.status==='Scheduled';
    return `<tr><td style="font-weight:500">${escHtml(r.guard_name)}</td><td style="font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)">${escHtml(r.guard_type||'—')}</td><td>${escHtml(r.farm||'—')}</td><td>${escHtml(r.shift_type||'—')}</td><td style="font-size:12px">${fmtFull(r.start_date)}</td><td style="font-size:12px">${fmtFull(r.end_date)}</td><td><span class="badge ${r.status==='Active'?'b-in':'b-out'}">${escHtml(r.status||'—')}</span></td><td><div class="row-actions">${canCancel?`<button class="btn btn-sm" title="Rotate to a different farm" onclick='rotateAssignmentFromRow(${attrJson(r)})'><i class="fa-solid fa-rotate"></i></button><button class="btn btn-sm" onclick='cancelAssignment(${attrJson(r.name)})'><i class="fa-solid fa-ban"></i></button>`:''}</div></td></tr>`;
  }).join(''):'<tr><td colspan="8" class="empty">No shift assignments in this range</td></tr>';

  const nb=document.getElementById('nb-shifts');if(nb)nb.textContent=s.total_assignments||0;
}
function shiftGuardTypeChanged(){
  document.getElementById('shGuardSearch').value='';
  document.getElementById('shGuardId').value='';
  document.getElementById('shGuardResults').classList.remove('open');
}
function shiftGuardSearch(q){
  clearTimeout(shGuardSearchTimer);
  document.getElementById('shGuardId').value='';
  const resultsEl=document.getElementById('shGuardResults');
  if(!q||q.trim().length<2){resultsEl.classList.remove('open');resultsEl.innerHTML='';return;}
  shGuardSearchTimer=setTimeout(async()=>{
    const guardType=document.querySelector('input[name="shGuardType"]:checked').value;
    try{
      const list=await callMethod('upande_security.api.security_dashboard.search_guards_for_shift',{guard_type:guardType,query:q.trim()});
      resultsEl.innerHTML=(list||[]).map(g=>`<div class="guard-search-item" onclick='shiftGuardPick(${attrJson(g.name)},${attrJson(g.label)})'>${escHtml(g.label)} <span style="color:var(--hint)">(${escHtml(g.name)})</span></div>`).join('')||'<div class="guard-search-item" style="color:var(--hint)">No matches</div>';
      resultsEl.classList.add('open');
    }catch(e){
      resultsEl.innerHTML=`<div class="guard-search-item" style="color:var(--hint)">Error: ${escHtml(e.message)}</div>`;
      resultsEl.classList.add('open');
    }
  },300);
}
function shiftGuardPick(id,label){
  document.getElementById('shGuardId').value=id;
  document.getElementById('shGuardSearch').value=label;
  document.getElementById('shGuardResults').classList.remove('open');
}
function openShiftModal(mode,prefill){
  shModalMode=mode;
  document.getElementById('shFormError').style.display='none';
  document.getElementById('shGuardSearch').value='';
  document.getElementById('shGuardId').value='';
  document.getElementById('shRotateFrom').value='';
  document.querySelector('input[name="shGuardType"][value="Internal Guard"]').checked=true;
  document.getElementById('shFormShiftType').value=(prefill&&prefill.shift_type)||'Day';
  shEndTouched=false;
  const startDefault=nowDatetimeLocal();
  document.getElementById('shFormStart').value=startDefault;
  document.getElementById('shFormEnd').value=addHoursToDatetimeLocal(startDefault,SHIFT_DEFAULT_HOURS);
  document.getElementById('shFormRemarks').value='';
  if(prefill&&prefill.farm) document.getElementById('shFormFarm').value=prefill.farm;
  if(mode==='rotate'&&prefill){
    document.getElementById('shModalTitle').textContent='Rotate '+(prefill.guard_name||'Guard')+' to a new farm';
    document.getElementById('shSubmitBtn').innerHTML='<i class="fa-solid fa-rotate"></i>Rotate Guard';
    document.getElementById('shRotateFrom').value=prefill.rotate_from||'';
    if(prefill.guard_type){document.querySelector(`input[name="shGuardType"][value="${prefill.guard_type}"]`).checked=true;}
    if(prefill.guard_id){document.getElementById('shGuardId').value=prefill.guard_id;}
    if(prefill.guard_name){document.getElementById('shGuardSearch').value=prefill.guard_name;}
  }else{
    document.getElementById('shModalTitle').textContent='New Shift Assignment';
    document.getElementById('shSubmitBtn').innerHTML='<i class="fa-solid fa-check"></i>Save Assignment';
  }
  document.getElementById('shModalBackdrop').classList.add('open');
}
function closeShiftModal(){
  document.getElementById('shModalBackdrop').classList.remove('open');
}
// Rotate straight from a coverage-board cell (guard identity not resolvable to id there, so re-search is required)
function rotateAssignmentPrompt(farm,shiftType,guardName){
  const rows=(window.__shLastRows||[]);
  const match=rows.find(r=>r.farm===farm&&r.shift_type===shiftType&&r.guard_name===guardName&&r.status==='Active');
  if(match) return rotateAssignmentFromRow(match);
  openShiftModal('rotate',{guard_name:guardName});
}
function rotateAssignmentFromRow(r){
  openShiftModal('rotate',{
    rotate_from:r.name,
    guard_type:r.guard_type,
    guard_id:r.guard_key?r.guard_key.split('::')[1]:'',
    guard_name:r.guard_name,
  });
}
async function cancelAssignment(name){
  if(!confirm('Cancel this shift assignment?'))return;
  try{
    await callMethod('frappe.client.set_value',{doctype:'Security Guard Shift Assignment',name,fieldname:'status',value:'Cancelled'});
    loadShifts();
  }catch(e){
    alert('Could not cancel: '+e.message);
  }
}
async function submitShiftForm(){
  const errEl=document.getElementById('shFormError');
  errEl.style.display='none';
  const guardType=document.querySelector('input[name="shGuardType"]:checked').value;
  const guardId=document.getElementById('shGuardId').value;
  const farm=document.getElementById('shFormFarm').value;
  const shiftType=document.getElementById('shFormShiftType').value;
  const start=document.getElementById('shFormStart').value;
  const end=document.getElementById('shFormEnd').value;
  const remarks=document.getElementById('shFormRemarks').value;
  const rotateFrom=document.getElementById('shRotateFrom').value;

  if(!guardId){errEl.textContent='Pick a guard from the search results.';errEl.style.display='block';return;}
  if(!farm){errEl.textContent='Farm is required.';errEl.style.display='block';return;}
  if(!start||!end){errEl.textContent='Start and end date/time are required.';errEl.style.display='block';return;}
  if(end<start){errEl.textContent='End date/time must be on or after the start date/time.';errEl.style.display='block';return;}

  const [startDate,startTimeRaw]=start.split('T');
  const [endDate,endTimeRaw]=end.split('T');
  const startTime=startTimeRaw+':00',endTime=endTimeRaw+':00';
  const doc={
    doctype:'Security Guard Shift Assignment',
    security_guard:guardType,
    farm,shift_type:shiftType,
    start_date:startDate,start_time:startTime,
    end_date:endDate,end_time:endTime,
    status:'Active',remarks,
  };
  if(guardType==='Internal Guard') doc.internal_guard=guardId; else doc.external_guard=guardId;

  const submitBtn=document.getElementById('shSubmitBtn');
  submitBtn.disabled=true;
  try{
    if(rotateFrom){
      // Old assignment hands over the instant the new one starts — no gap, no overlap.
      await callMethod('frappe.client.set_value',{doctype:'Security Guard Shift Assignment',name:rotateFrom,fieldname:{end_date:startDate,end_time:startTime}});
    }
    await callMethod('frappe.client.insert',{doc});
    closeShiftModal();
    loadShifts();
  }catch(e){
    errEl.textContent='Could not save: '+e.message;
    errEl.style.display='block';
  }finally{
    submitBtn.disabled=false;
  }
}

<script>
(function(){
  function statCard(label, value, color){
    return '<div style="background:#fff;border:1px solid #e5e7eb;border-radius:10px;padding:14px 18px;min-width:140px;">'
      + '<div style="font-size:12px;color:#6b7280;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em;">'+escHtml(label)+'</div>'
      + '<div style="font-size:26px;font-weight:700;color:'+(color||'#111827')+';margin-top:4px;">'+escHtml(value)+'</div>'
      + '</div>';
  }

  function renderTable(el, rows, keyField, keyLabel, valLabel){
    if(!rows || !rows.length){ el.innerHTML = '<tr><td style="padding:6px 0;color:#9ca3af;">No data</td></tr>'; return; }
    var html = '<tr><th style="text-align:left;padding:4px 0;color:#6b7280;font-weight:600;">'+escHtml(keyLabel)+'</th><th style="text-align:right;padding:4px 0;color:#6b7280;font-weight:600;">'+escHtml(valLabel)+'</th></tr>';
    rows.forEach(function(r){
      html += '<tr><td style="padding:4px 0;border-top:1px solid #f3f4f6;">'+escHtml(r[keyField])+'</td><td style="padding:4px 0;border-top:1px solid #f3f4f6;text-align:right;">'+escHtml(r.cnt)+'</td></tr>';
    });
    el.innerHTML = html;
  }

  async function loadSecurityAnalytics(){
    try {
      const data = await callMethod('security_analytics_summary', {});
      if (!data || data.error) { console.error('Analytics error:', data && data.error); return; }

      const capaColor = data.capa_overdue_count > 0 ? '#dc2626' : '#111827';
      const coverageColor = (data.patrol_coverage_pct != null && data.patrol_coverage_pct < 50) ? '#dc2626' : '#16a34a';
      const totalIncidents = (data.incidents_by_severity||[]).reduce(function(s,r){return s+r.cnt;},0);

      document.getElementById('secAnalyticsCards').innerHTML =
        statCard('Incidents (30d)', totalIncidents) +
        statCard('Near Misses (30d)', data.near_miss_count_30d) +
        statCard('Open CAPA Actions', data.capa_open_count, capaColor) +
        statCard('Overdue CAPA', data.capa_overdue_count, data.capa_overdue_count > 0 ? '#dc2626' : '#111827') +
        statCard('Patrol Coverage', (data.patrol_coverage_pct != null ? data.patrol_coverage_pct + '%' : 'n/a'), coverageColor);

      renderTable(document.getElementById('secAnalyticsLocTable'), data.incidents_by_location, 'location', 'Location', 'Incidents');
      renderTable(document.getElementById('secAnalyticsVisitorTable'), data.visitor_daily_trend, 'day', 'Day', 'Check-ins');
    } catch(e) {
      console.error('Failed to load security analytics:', e);
    }
  }

  loadSecurityAnalytics();
  setInterval(loadSecurityAnalytics, 600000);
})();
</script>
